title: REST-запрос
semantics: Native REST through a separate module connection. HTTP method/body/media types, URL parameters and custom headers are independently configured. Output 0 RequestID/Response text; output 1 RequestID/ErrorCode/ErrorDesc/HttpStatusCode. Read actual status and join by RequestID. Omitted existing settings are preserved; native retry only. Saved auth credentials never enter readback. Stage-0 proposal; capabilities require owner approval and per-cycle implementation.

name.description: Module label; reuse only with same URL/ordered query names; else NEW name/base_url.

base_url.description: New native connection absolute HTTP(S) URL, without embedded credentials. URL definitions and template handling follow the approved URL cycle.

response_content_type.description: Allowed response media type or explicit */*. Independent of request media type.

method.description: New default GET; omit on existing to preserve. Body field only for POST/PUT/PATCH.

request_content_type.description: Native request media type; default text/plain. Sent UTF-8; charset may be appended.

url_mode.description: Native placement of ordered URL parameters; raw string input, exactly one encoding pass.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds; distinct from overall timeout_seconds.

verify_server_certificate.description: Default true; false needs explicit user instruction and separately approved acceptance.

authentication.description: Reuse operator-prepared named native connection. No credential values in model input or readback. New credential creation deferred.

field.description: Observed string field, input0. Raw values only; handler adds URL encoding. No pre-encoding/codec node.

query_parameters.description: All query bindings in order, to raw input fields. Handler URL-encodes once before native REST; preserves source table.

body_field.description: String table-input field sent unchanged as UTF-8 for POST/PUT/PATCH. Never URL-encode body.

headers.description: Explicit complete custom list; [] clears. Omit preserves. Unique case-insensitive names, no CR/LF or credentials. Variables require separate native variables input.

timeout_seconds.description: Overall native request timeout in seconds. Does not change agent deadlines.

retries.description: Native repeats after error. No extra recovery retries. Exact attempt acceptance deferred.

retry_delay_ms.description: Native delay between failed attempts; only active when retries>0.

request_delay_ms.description: Delay between input-row requests in milliseconds.

simulation.description: Use delivered server-side response file instead of transport; null disables. Omit preserves.

request_dump.description: Save native requests only to an operator-prepared empty private folder. null disables; omission preserves. No credentials in dumps. File acceptance needs owner approval; CSV alone is insufficient.

produce_error_descriptions.description: New default true; omit on existing to preserve. false removes ErrorDesc from native output 1, leaving RequestID/ErrorCode/HttpStatusCode. Read actual field layout.

parameter_schema.description: Stage-0 additive proposal for mode request. Explicit table settings use finish=execute. Preserve unspecified saved settings. Reuse connection only when its URL, method, ordered URL definitions, auth and TLS match; otherwise use a new name. Body/header source fields survive query encoding. Variable input is distinct from table input. Secret entry, certificate fixtures, exact retry proof and scopes beyond observed UI require owner decisions. Existing parameters:{} preserves settings.
